content: std::simd remains nightly-only (feature portable_simd, tracking issue rust-lang/rust#86656); stable std docs mark all items experimental. packed_simd 0.3.9 deprecated and nightly-only, superseded by std::simd. Both disqualified at MSRV 1.80. Stable path: std::arch intrinsics - aarch64 NEON stable since Rust 1.59 (verified releases.rs), x86 SSE2/AVX2 with is_x86_feature_detected runtime dispatch. Portable-SIMD crates: wide 1.7.1 MSRV 1.89 FAIL, wide 0.7.33 MSRV 1.61 PASS (pinnable), fearless_simd 1.2.0 MSRV 1.89 FAIL, macerator 0.5.2 MSRV 1.94 FAIL, pulp 0.22.3 MSRV undeclared. simdutf8 0.1.5 is UTF-8 validation only - irrelevant to DNA 2-bit encoding.
